recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future normative changes to mimeType or maxSize should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack definitions, with core narrative updates only if the core build references those extension categories incorrectly.
issue_request: FHIR-5744 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking that two attachment-related common Questionnaire extensions be moved to the generic element extensions profile because they can apply to profiled elements, extension definitions, and data elements beyond Questionnaire.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify SVN #4165 as pre-applied. Git commit e4f5c0d73d001a82fba48ff47d65a7154166c19c is that git-svn application and removed mimeType and maxSize from the old Questionnaire extension spreadsheet while refactoring the shared Questionnaire extension design. Later source reorganization added the element-extensions profile under source/profiles with mimeType and maxSize defined for Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition.
additional_context: Questionnaire and the element-extensions profile are active current-build source entries in source/fhir.ini. Current core no longer owns these extension StructureDefinitions directly after the R5 extension-definition removal from the core checkout; the FHIR Extension Pack now defines mimeType and maxSize with Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition contexts and Attachment-only comments. The current core element-extensions introduction still classifies mimeType and maxSize as attachment-related element extensions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current definitions are generic element-related extensions rather than Questionnaire-only extensions, and no current core source location requires a corrective edit for this issue.
